SEPTEMBER 2026 – FEBRUARY 2028

The full 18-month road trip

Eight connected milestones—from training 12 adult educators in Madeira to local creative workshops, an open Methods Manual, four awareness campaigns, three city exhibitions, a 3D VR gallery and final conferences.

STOP 01 15–16 Sep 2026 Bonn, Germany DONE

Kick-off in Germany

Project coordinators from Integrational e.V. (Germany), Associação Ramifica (Portugal) and Modern Gelişim Derneği (Türkiye) align the 18-month roadmap, safeguarding rules, evaluation instruments and outreach schedule.

  • Host organisation: Integrational e.V. (Bonn, Germany)
  • Outputs: Partnership agreement, Quality & Evaluation plan, safeguarding and photo-consent workflows.
STOP 02 9–15 Nov 2026 Funchal, Madeira (Portugal) DONE

Training course in Madeira

12 adult educators (4 per country) spend a week in Madeira practising and co-designing safe, non-clinical creative workshops using drawing, storytelling, drama and music.

  • Host organisation: Associação Ramifica (Funchal, Madeira)
  • Participants: 12 adult educators (4 from Germany, 4 from Portugal, 4 from Türkiye).
  • Focus: Peer-testing drawing, storytelling, drama and music sessions with clear non-clinical safety boundaries.
STOP 03 Bonn 18 Jan, Madeira 19 Jan, Eskişehir 20 Jan 2027 Bonn · Madeira · Eskişehir WE ARE HERE

Three local workshops

One-day creative adult education workshops for 60 adult learners aged 25+ (20 per city, at least half with fewer opportunities). Free to attend, no art skills required.

  • Planned dates: Bonn (18 Jan 2027), Madeira (19 Jan 2027), Eskişehir (20 Jan 2027).
  • Participants: 60 adult learners aged 25+ (20 per city, at least half with fewer opportunities).
  • Free of charge, no art skills required. Reserve a place on the Home page.
STOP 04 10 Feb 2027 Online (Germany · Portugal · Türkiye) UPCOMING

Multicultural online hub

Learners and facilitators from all three countries connect online to share artworks, stories and reflections across borders in a facilitated session.

  • Date: 10 February 2027 (Online session across all three partner cities).
  • Focus: Cross-cultural exchange where adult learners from Bonn, Madeira and Eskişehir share creative works and reflections with live translation support by facilitators.
STOP 05 1 Mar – 22 Apr 2027 Open-access PDF in English UPCOMING

Methods Manual (4 chapters)

Co-authoring and publishing our practical 4-chapter Methods Manual covering drawing, storytelling, drama and music activities for adult mental well-being and inclusion.

  • Timeline: 1 March – 22 April 2027.
  • Four chapters: Drawing & Visual Expression, Storytelling, Drama & Movement, Music & Rhythm.
  • Published as a free English PDF on the Downloads shelf.
STOP 06 May – Sep 2027 Local & online across 3 countries UPCOMING

Four awareness campaigns

Four thematic awareness campaigns challenging mental-health stigma and isolation among adults, complete with downloadable social and poster packs.

  • Timeline: May – September 2027.
  • Four coordinated local and online awareness campaigns reducing stigma around adult mental well-being and social isolation.
STOP 07 Oct 2027 – Jan 2028 Bonn · Madeira · Eskişehir · Artsteps VR UPCOMING

Three exhibitions (3 weeks each) + VR gallery

Three-week community exhibitions in each partner city showcasing consenting learners’ works alongside our permanent 3D virtual exhibition on Artsteps.

  • Timeline: October 2027 – January 2028.
  • Three local physical exhibitions (running 3 weeks in each partner city) + launch of the Artsteps 3D VR gallery.
STOP 08 Feb 2028 Bonn · Madeira · Eskişehir UPCOMING

Final conferences in three countries + final meeting in Eskişehir

Live method demonstrations, publication of pre/post evaluation findings, local multiplier conferences in all three countries and final project meeting in Eskişehir.

  • Timeline: February 2028.
  • Local multiplier conferences with live method demonstrations in Germany, Portugal and Türkiye, publication of pre/post evaluation results, and final project meeting hosted by Modern Gelişim Derneği in Eskişehir.
